basics.description:
Entre Technology Services - Azure Lighthouse onboarding.

Sign in to the CUSTOMER tenant with an account that holds OWNER on the target subscription, select the subscription to delegate, choose a deployment region, and enter the customer name. This delegates the subscription to Entre's managing tenant using the standard role model (Reader, Contributor, Cost Management Contributor, Reservation Purchaser).

location.label: Deployment region
location.toolTip: Region used to store the deployment record. Azure Lighthouse resources are not regional; any region is fine.

basics.name: mspOfferName
basics.label: Customer name
basics.toolTip: The customer name Entre will see under Azure Lighthouse -> My customers, and the customer will see under Service providers. Must be unique per subscription (e.g., 'BotR' or 'AdvR Inc'). Allowed characters: letters, numbers, spaces, periods, underscores, and hyphens. Commas are not allowed.

constraints.validationMessage: 3-80 characters. Letters, numbers, spaces, periods, underscores, and hyphens only. No commas.

basics.name: mspOfferDescription
basics.label: Delegation description (optional)
basics.defaultValue: Entre Technology Services - Azure Lighthouse delegated management
basics.toolTip: Optional description shown to the customer under Service providers.

options.text: Managing tenant: Entre Technology Services (55705222-2816-4f25-8c0e-f9fa312aa10c). Roles delegated: Reader, Contributor, Cost Management Contributor, Reservation Purchaser, plus delegation-removal rights for Operations Admins. You must sign in with an account that holds Owner on the target subscription; a guest account will not work.
